# اِنْتَعَشْتِ (intaʕašti) /in.ta.ʕaʃ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْتَعَشَ (intaʕaša)
# اِنْتَعَشَتْ (intaʕašat) /in.ta.ʕa.ʃat/: third-perso
